header.note: Encoders A/B/C (capacity/strict/periodic) each produce an EncoderVector: `input` is a tagged-JSON value tree ($undefined/$bigint/$number/$arr/$obj/$map tags disambiguate values with no native JSON representation, or where object/array/Map order fidelity must survive the JSON round-trip exactly); `outcome` is "value" (expected holds the real encoder's rendered string), "undefined" (the real encoder returned the literal JS `undefined` value, only possible for a bare top-level `undefined` input), or "throws" (the real encoder threw synchronously, currently only reachable for Encoder C given a `bigint` anywhere in the input). Encoder D (canonicalToken/canonicalNumber/canonicalRecord/canonicalEntryListKey) vectors are plain string/array-of-strings input/output pairs (no tagging needed).
